coverage: A bounded review of public creative, navigation and runtime contracts. Absence of an edge means not recorded, not no relationship.

relationships.summary: Domistika writes Creative Bridge v2 artwork; Auralith mounts a receiver for the same browser-local bridge.
relationships.scope: Source inspection confirms sender/receiver code and the shared bridge key. Transfer integrity, user approval and matching deployed versions still govern actual imports. This is not an npm dependency or a reproduced runtime session.

evidence.claim: The sender targets the public Auralith app and writes the v2 bridge key.
The receiver reads the same v2 bridge key and validates the protocol.
The application imports and mounts DomistikaBridgeReceiver.

relationships.summary: Silicon Louvre and Domistika implement a matching, short-lived SVG handoff.
relationships.scope: Source inspection confirms matching key, schema and target. Same-origin conditions and explicit visitor approval apply. No artwork is transferred by this map and no end-to-end run is claimed.

evidence.claim: The sender declares the Domistika destination, schema, key and same-origin guard.
The receiver declares the matching schema/key and validates the handoff.

relationships.summary: The Atlas provides a permanent link to the independent Future Archive gallery.
relationships.scope: Verified source-level navigation link. The gallery remains independently hosted; no shared runtime or copied artwork is implied.

evidence.claim: Renders the permanent Future Archive navigation link.

relationships.summary: Future Archive builds Atlas chapter links for its known starter chapters and otherwise opens the Atlas entrance.
relationships.scope: Verified URL-building code, not evidence that every gallery print has a chapter or that a returning visitor has retained that chapter.

evidence.claim: Defines the Atlas destination and bounded chapter allowlist.
The print viewer renders the Atlas link using the URL builder.

relationships.summary: Both manifests declare React and react-dom; their pinned version ranges differ.
relationships.scope: A shared library declaration only. Auralith declares React 18; Future Archive declares React 19. No shared package instance, interoperability or direct repository dependency is inferred.

relationships.summary: PhiCade documents a pinned PixelForge Runtime Bridge v1 JSONL adapter and qualification target.
relationships.scope: The public document describes a local runtime contract and records a qualification target. This milestone does not reproduce its qualification or claim that the public browser apps are connected.

evidence.claim: Describes the transport seam, separate responsibilities and exact source pin.

relationships.summary: Auralith documents a candidate creative interoperability profile with ParaCut as the next stage.
relationships.scope: Candidate profile only, explicitly marked candidate in the source. Receiver behavior and deployment compatibility are not verified by this map.

evidence.claim: Names the candidate Domistika → Auralith → ParaCut → WaveForge chain and profile hash.

relationships.summary: The same public candidate profile names ParaCut and WaveForgeStudio as consecutive stages.
relationships.scope: Documented candidate chain, not an asserted operational pipeline. Evidence is a published statement in Auralith; no receiver-side acceptance is claimed.

evidence.claim: Names ParaCut and WaveForgeStudio in the candidate chain.
